name: Raqcoin
milestone_note: The 2018 milestone is ABCMint genesis, not UOV deployment. Community materials describe a 2022 rename.
signing: RainbowPro and UOV configurations; multisig is a separate capability.
crypto_agility: Key configuration selects the signing scheme. Existing keys do not change automatically.
limits: The guide lists Rainbow configuration 274 as the default. Legacy ABCMint Rainbow parameters have a public break. New configurations require separate analysis; NIST UOV candidate parameters are not Raqcoin deployment parameters.

name: Mochimo
crypto_agility: One active signing scheme in the reviewed material.
limits: Consensus changed; the signing scheme remained WOTS+. No claim that a future protocol upgrade could never change it.

name: QRL
crypto_agility: Hash-function choice and descriptor fields; not arbitrary switching between signature families.
limits: XMSS is stateful. The RFC size example is not QRL transaction serialization.

name: Nexus
milestone_note: November 2019 is the Tritium upgrade, not the original chain genesis in 2014.
signing: Opt-in Falcon-512; classical Brainpool signatures remain valid.
crypto_agility: Signature chains commit to a subsequent key and scheme.
limits: Do not treat every Nexus account as post-quantum.

name: Tidecoin
signing: Falcon-512 active; Falcon-1024 and ML-DSA exist in upgrade code.
crypto_agility: Multiple schemes are implemented behind an activation gate.
limits: Implemented upgrade support does not establish that it is active on mainnet.

name: Starknet
milestone_note: November 2021 is L2 Mainnet Alpha, not an independent L1 launch.
signing: STARK validity proofs and a Falcon-512 account demonstration.
crypto_agility: Account abstraction and contract upgrades can change account verification logic.
limits: A Falcon account demo is not migration of every account. Ethereum settlement and bridge dependencies remain. The L1 vote supported research, not a move.

name: Abelian
crypto_agility: Versioned cryptographic schemes; mining algorithm choice is a separate matter.
limits: These schemes are not ML-DSA. Dual PoW does not mean PoW plus PoS. QDay is a separate L2.

name: Algorand
milestone_note: The timeline uses the 2022 State Proofs milestone. The chain launched in 2019.
signing: Falcon State Proofs and opt-in Falcon account authorization.
crypto_agility: Rekeying and programmable authorization; native Falcon-1024 accounts are also documented.
limits: State Proofs and account signing have different roles. Consensus participation keys remain classical; app and wallet support still matters.

name: Cellframe
signing: Native-wallet options include Dilithium, Falcon and SPHINCS+.
crypto_agility: Multiple native signing schemes, subject to network and wallet support.
limits: Scope is native CF-20 assets, not ERC-20/BEP-20 tokens. Picnic is a historical/deprecated route, not a current wallet option in this release.

name: QuantumCoin
signing: Hybrid post-quantum and Ed25519 signing; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA components.
crypto_agility: Signing modes change at protocol thresholds and in emergency mode.
limits: Do not assume every protocol phase uses exactly the same component combination. ML-KEM node handshakes are not transaction signatures.

name: QANplatform
milestone_note: May 2024 is the public testnet announcement, not a public mainnet launch.
crypto_agility: A fixed signature pairing in the reviewed XLINK path.
limits: The traded QANX token does not establish a live native post-quantum mainnet. The original 2024 announcement used the Dilithium name; do not backdate current parameters.

name: Neptune Cash
milestone_note: First launch in February 2025; the current chain relaunched on August 5, 2025.
signing: Hash-preimage spending conditions and Triton STARK validity proofs.
limits: A STARK proof and a hash-preimage spending condition are not a fixed-size standard digital signature.

name: Nervos CKB
timeline_milestone: Jan · SPHINCS+ lock deployed on mainnet
milestone_note: January 2026 marks the SPHINCS+ lock deployment. CKB mainnet launched in 2019.
crypto_agility: New verification logic can be deployed as lock scripts.
limits: Existing cells must satisfy their old spending rules before migration. Default secp256k1 cells do not change automatically.

name: Quantus
limits: ML-DSA-65 requires runtime spec 139 or later and compatible account tooling. Quantus and qtcchain both use QTC but are separate chains.

name: xCoin
milestone_note: The project whitepaper dates mainnet genesis to September 26, 2026.
signing: ML-DSA-65 primary signing; SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s fallback leaves.
crypto_agility: Cross-family fallback requires committing to the alternative spending leaf in advance.
limits: This is not a claim that every spend carries both signatures or that a new fallback can be added after a key is compromised.

name: qtcchain
milestone_note: v1 launched September 30, 2026; v2 re-genesis was October 5, 2026.
crypto_agility: Per-key scheme selection and multiple script leaves.
limits: Falcon is reserved in the reviewed specification. qtcchain is unrelated to Quantus despite the shared QTC ticker. The repository records a v2 treasury allocation; inclusion is not a fair-launch endorsement.

name: Soqucoin
milestone_note: Mainnet block 1 was mined on October 13, 2026.
crypto_agility: One active transaction-signing scheme in the snapshot.
limits: XMSS experiments are not counted as a mainnet signing path. Public blocks do not establish user adoption or independent security certification.
